hq_location.notes: Company profile lists San Francisco, California; EquityZen identifies San Francisco, CA, US.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes getting started, SDKs, versioning, template design, and other reference sections.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round, February 25, 2021, predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

last_funding.notes: Lob announced $50 million in Series C financing on February 25, 2021, led by Y Combinator Continuity. Funding profiles identify this as its latest round.

launched_6mo.notes: August 31, 2026 announcement introduces the No-Code Design Suite, including visual template editing, dynamic personalization, conversion of InDesign/Figma designs, and a reusable Design Library. This falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

pricing_page.notes: Public Developer, Small Business, Growth, and Enterprise plans.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive opening appears on the current portfolio job board and has a public role listing with an application link.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public API documentation, security and privacy pages, the subprocessor list, and searched Lob's blog for model-provider disclosures. No product-use disclosure was found. Blog mentions of ChatGPT as a marketing tool do not establish that Lob's product uses it.

named_customers.notes: Both case studies explicitly describe customers using Lob's automated direct mail platform.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists five open roles: Partner Operations Manager, Enterprise Account Executive, Business Operations Manager, Senior Manager USPS Programs, and Corporate Counsel. None has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

compliance_certs.notes: Lob claims annual SOC 2 Type 2 audits, HIPAA/HITECH privacy audits and BAAs, and practices supporting GDPR. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not independent certifications. No ISO 27001 or PCI DSS claim was found on this page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies Salesforce for customer management/support, Marketo and Mutiny for sales lead management, Mailchimp for email marketing, and Segment for data management. The integrations page names Braze and Iterable; those are integration capabilities, not proof of Lob's internal use.

product_one_liner.value: Lob helps businesses automate, personalize, print, send, and track direct mail at scale through campaign tools, APIs, and a nationwide print delivery network.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: November 12, 2025 announcement names David Pickel as CFO, Raji Bedi as CPO, and Paul Rosen as CRO, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.
